Rotation: observation-weighted mean of the refined rigs of three v0p20 rational Navcam solutions (Three Forks, Bell Island, Rockytop), consistent with M2020_N{L,R}_rational.json; they agree to 0.15 mrad. The translation is the CAHV baseline, which MPPP holds (it sets the scale). SfmProject.create(navcam_rig='consensus') starts the rig rotation here and keeps the project's CAHV translation.
